what: A static web tool for a 2013 Camaro RS. Its main page, Fender Fit Lab, loads a local STL and shows a Three.js fender-fit sandbox. The repo also holds a diagnostics project for the car's electrical faults.
audience: The car owner and technical helpers who inspect and fit a replacement passenger fender.
landing_job: Open the 3D fender-fit tool at index.html and explain how to rotate, pan, cut and place the fender slice.

surfaces.where: index.html (Fender Fit Lab, Three.js + STLLoader viewer)

identity.look: A calm engineering look: pale blue-grey page, navy text, glass-like white panels with soft shadows, one orange accent and one teal highlight, with a monospace face for readouts.

type.family: Google Fonts css2 link for both families

notes: No design-system folder, tokens file or brand book exists. The page defines 17 colour and radius tokens on :root (index.html:12-28), so a formalized system needs no new choices. docs/superpowers/specs holds feature design notes, not a brand system. No logo file exists; the wordmark is plain type: 'Camaro Fender Fit Lab' in h1 (index.html:430).
